summary: Iteration 8: Reply Templates and Daily Lead Digest. Backend: new tests/test_templates_digest.py, 16/16 passed. The first GET (4 concurrent calls) seeded exactly 3 builtin defaults with the right form_types and no _id. Template CRUD works: create, list, update and GET-verify, delete, then a second delete gives 404. Unknown PUT gives 404. 422 for an empty name, an empty body, an 81-char name and a missing name. Finance gets 403 on POST/PUT/DELETE, on send-now and also on GET. Unauthenticated calls get 401. Cron: 401 with no Bearer and with a wrong Bearer. A valid Bearer returns 202 {accepted:true} in 0.12s. A duplicate X-Webhook-Id returns duplicate:true. A non-object body returns 400. crons.yml has '0 8 * * *' Africa/Lagos. IMPORTANT FINDING: the background digest from my cron call (run TEST_run_00659409...) SENT successfully to hello@amass.africa (email_id 01a19087-9689..., 0 new yesterday, 16 pending, status done). The log at 05:54 still showed undeliverable_recipient, so the mailbox started accepting mail between 05:54 and 05:56. Because of this, the expected 'can't receive email' toast could NOT be reproduced. Instead, clicking 'Email digest now' within 2 min showed the 429 toast 'A digest was just sent. Please wait a couple of minutes.', which correctly shows the rate limit works after a real send. Frontend: the schedule text reads 'Daily digest to hello@amass.africa, 8:00 am Lagos time · last sent 10/31/2026, 5:56:07 AM'. The Reply dialog on the TEST agent lead lists 'Agent sign-up · suggested' first, then Demo booking and Property listing. Picking a template fills the message box, the text is editable, and Send stays enabled (NOT clicked). On the Templates tab, 3 cards are shown and New template opens the editor. Save is disabled while the form is empty. Creating TEST_ui_tpl (Contact) worked and the tab count went to 4. Edit opened prefilled and renamed it to TEST_ui_tpl_edited. Delete (window.confirm) removed it and the count went back to 3. Regression: the leads list (12 rows, stats 16/12/0/4) and Website Content load. The only console error was the expected 429.

minor.issue: A whitespace-only name/body ('   ') is accepted (200), because min_length runs before any strip. The UI blocks it with trim(), but the API does not. Strip in a validator and return 422.

The seed check (find meta, then insert_many, then insert meta) is not atomic. Two concurrent first calls (for example React StrictMode double-mount) could insert 6 defaults. It did not happen in my 4-way concurrent test, but use an upsert on the meta key (or a unique index) to guard it.
Requires leads view, so finance gets 403. That is fine, just confirming it is intended.

action_items: Be aware that hello@amass.africa now ACCEPTS mail. One real digest was delivered at 05:56:07 UTC by my cron test. The undeliverable toast path could not be retested live. The code path (422 with the clear message) was reviewed and looks correct.
Reject whitespace-only template name/body on the backend (422).
Make template seeding atomic (upsert meta key / unique index).
critical_code_review_comments: Cron failures are only logged and stored on cron_runs.status='failed'. Nothing in the UI shows that the 8am digest failed. Consider showing the last failed run in digest-schedule-text.
send-now rate limit is based only on last successful send, so repeated failing clicks each hit the email API (acceptable, as designed).
_run_digest via asyncio.create_task has no reference kept; task could be GC'd in rare cases—store in a set.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested flows; the undeliverable toast was not reproducible because the mailbox now works)

seed_data_creation: The 3 default templates were seeded by the first GET, which was the intended behaviour. The TEST_ templates I created were deleted, so 3 remain. My cron_runs doc (TEST_run_*) was deleted and cron_runs is empty. meta.last_lead_digest was left in place because it records the real send. No lead changes and no reply emails. One digest email went to hello@amass.africa.
